name: Verizon Visa® Card

apr.notes: Purchase APR not stated on product page. 0% APR financing with 36 equal monthly payments on select device purchases with Verizon Visa Card for Verizon Wireless customers.

fx_fee.notes: No additional, surprise fees on foreign transactions.

base_rate.description: 1% on all other purchases where Visa credit cards are accepted.

categories.label: Verizon wireless or Fios bill payment

rewards.redemption_notes: Verizon Dollars can be used toward Verizon bill, smartwatch, headphones, 5G phone, gaming consoles, and accessories. There's no limit on the amount of Verizon Dollars you can earn for purchases. Verizon Dollars will be forfeited for Rewards Program inactivity.

signup_bonus.description: Get a $50 statement credit when you open an account and make a purchase in the first 90 days. Get an additional $100 statement credit when you spend $1500 using your card in the first 90 days. Limited time offer.

benefits.title: Auto Pay savings
benefits.description: New enrollees to Verizon's Auto Pay can get up to $10/mo off each eligible wireless phone line, up to 12 lines max (depending on plan) and/or $10/mo off each eligible Fios service.

benefits.title: 0% APR device financing
benefits.description: Verizon Wireless customers get 0% APR financing with 36 equal monthly payments on select device purchases with Verizon Visa Card.

notes: Verified from official product page. Rewards currency is Verizon Dollars. Eligibility: must be Verizon Fios Account Owner with at least one active Fios service or Verizon wireless customer who is Account Owner or Account Manager with up to 12 phone lines. Upon credit card approval, all new card holders will receive a Verizon Visa Signature Card. Purchase APR not stated on page.
